---
title: "About I-ADOPT"
---

## Goal

The goal of I-ADOPT is to provide an Interoperability Framework for representing FAIR observable properties. 

## A brief History of the I-ADOPT Initiative
* 2018: Informal meetings between semantic experts to adress the need for a harmonized syntax to describe observable properties initiated by eLTER RI
* 2019 - 2021: **RDA Working Group InteroperAble Descriptions of Observable Property Terminology WG** [(RDA I-ADOPT WG)](https://i-adopt.github.io/rda.html)
* 2022: RDA Endorsment of the I-ADOPT Recommendations ([DOI: 10.15497/RDA00071](https://zenodo.org/records/6520132#.YnOhMJNBybQ))
* 2022 - 2024: Domain-specific vocabularies start implement I-ADOPT for their variables
* Autumn 2024: Two [I-ADOPT Variable Modelling Challenges](https://i-adopt.github.io/challenge.html)
* Spring 2025: Two [I-ADOPT Workshops](https://i-adopt.github.io/workshops.html)
* July - November 2025: **NFDI4Earth I-ADOPT project** to develop a prototype for an [LLM-assisted I-ADOPT service](https://i-adopt.github.io/service.html)
* 2025 - 2027: EU Horizon Europe [**FAIR2Adapt**](https://fair2adapt-eosc.eu/) project (No. 101188256) develops an I-ADOPT service embedded in [ROHub](https://www.rohub.org) to enable interoperable descriptions of RO-Crates
* June 2026 - May 2029: EU Horizon Europe [**CDIF4EOSC**](https://cdif4eosc.eu/) project (No. 101292473) will include I-ADOPT in their [Cross Domain Interoperability Framework](https://cross-domain-interoperability-framework.github.io/cdifbook/) as a Context Profile
* 2026 - 2027: Developing Extension specification to FAIRify the *observedproperty* in the [**OGC Observation, Measurement and Sample** standard](https://www.ogc.org/standards/om/) 
* 2026: The GO FAIR Foundation has assumed patronage over I-ADOPT developments to ensure the long-term preservation of the services and specification.
